difficulty_reason: Defines the canonical functor (F_{X,k,x_0})_{l/k} -> F_{X,l,x_{l,0}} by evaluating over B x_l k and pulling back along B x_l k ⊂ B; when (RS) holds, the ring diagram l <- B <- B x_l k over k exhibits Spec(B) as the pushout Spec(k) ⊔_{Spec(B x_l k)} Spec(l) of schemes, so (RS) gives an equivalence of fibre categories identifying the two functors, and the dual of the fibred-category equivalence lemma upgrades it to an equivalence of categories cofibred in groupoids.
